column1: # bioinfo reference store manifest  --  SOURCE OF TRUTH for /refs
# Every pipeline config refers to STANDARD paths only (never raw source filenames).
# Moving to a new machine: edit the SOURCE column, re-run bootstrap/04-refs.sh, done.
# columns: standard_path <TAB> mode <TAB> source <TAB> note <TAB> sha256
# mode:
#   link   symlink into SOURCE. Zero copy. Use for sequential-read files (FASTA, GTF, BED, JSON).
#   copy   materialize into ext4. Use for random-access-heavy files where /mnt/d I/O hurts.
#   build  generated locally by a tool. SOURCE is the command hint. Never symlinked.
#   fetch  must be downloaded. SOURCE is the URL or nf-core param that pulls it.
# sha256: optional, read by bootstrap/04-refs.sh --verify. Blank means nobody has
#   hashed that file yet, which is not an error. Fill it with 04-refs.sh --hash,
#   never by hand. Directories (trailing /) and unfetched entries stay blank.
# standard_path is relative to $BIOINFO_REFS (default /refs).
# SOURCE uses WSL paths. Windows D:\ is /mnt/d.
genomes/GRCh38/fasta/genome.fa
column4: UCSC-style hg38, chr-prefixed

column1: # Nextclade SARS-CoV-2 dataset (--nextclade_dataset). Runtime NEXTCLADE_DATASETGET (the
# pipeline's default when only --nextclade_dataset_name is set, not a full --nextclade_dataset
# path) needs https://data.clades.nextstrain.org -- THIS SPECIFIC HOST is intercepted by this
# box's corp TLS-inspecting proxy ("ePrism SSL" / SOOSAN INT, see bootstrap/06-tls-trust.sh's
# own worked example of get.nextflow.io being selectively intercepted the same way), confirmed
# via `docker run curlimages/curl ... data.clades.nextstrain.org` returning "self-signed
# certificate in certificate chain" while the HOST's own curl to the same URL succeeds (the
# corp CA is already trusted in the HOST system store from a prior 06-tls-trust.sh --accept run,
# but that trust does NOT propagate into a fresh docker container's own /etc/ssl/certs -- a
# genuinely different gap from every prior TLS-trust finding in this repo, which were all
# host-level). Routed around for this one-off manual fetch by mounting the host's
# /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt into the container and setting SSL_CERT_FILE -- the SAME
# fix would need to be applied inside the pipeline's own NEXTCLADE_DATASETGET container if
# --nextclade_dataset_name were used instead of a static path, which nf-core process containers
# have no mechanism to do; using a static, pre-fetched --nextclade_dataset instead sidesteps the
# problem entirely by never invoking NEXTCLADE_DATASETGET at all (confirmed via reading
# subworkflows/local/prepare_genome_illumina/main.nf:181 -- providing nextclade_dataset takes
# an if-branch that skips NEXTCLADE_DATASETGET outright).
db/nextclade/sars-cov-2/
column3: docker run --rm -v /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt:/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt:ro -e SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt -v /refs/db/nextclade/sars-cov-2:/out community.wave.seqera.io/library/nextclade:3.11.0--155203da8341cfe6 nextclade dataset get --name sars-cov-2 --output-dir /out
